`background-lossless.webp` is a generated, constant opaque-white 1×1 VP8L
fixture with no metadata, transforms, color cache, or animation.

`blue-purple-pink.lossy.webp` is the 150×100 VP8 test fixture from
`golang.org/x/image` v0.46.0. Its Go Authors copyright and BSD license are
preserved in `LICENSE-Go-Authors`; that license applies to this fixture only.
